convocatoria.vertices_es_la_revista_academica_de_econ: Vértices is the academic economics journal created by the student community of the Economics undergraduate program at Tec de Monterrey, Mexico City Campus. A journal by economists, for economists, and for anyone who wants to understand: rigorous in evidence and friendly to read. We publish research abstracts and papers, data-driven articles and visualizations, interviews and academic life content. The call for papers is open to students, degreed economists, data scientists and social scientists.

You receive a formal decision with strengths and areas for improvement.

lineamientos.antes_de_enviar_tu_pieza_revisa_los_line: Before submitting your piece, review the general guidelines and open the section you want to apply to: there you will find its requirements, its rubric and the closing checklist.
lineamientos.aplican_a_todas_las_secciones_salvo_que_: They apply to all sections, unless the section's block says otherwise. The guiding principle:
lineamientos.rigurosos_en_la_evidencia_amables_en_la_: rigorous in evidence, friendly to read
lineamientos.toda_pieza_equilibra_sustento_fuentes_me: . Every piece balances substance (sources, method, context) with accessibility (no unnecessary jargon).
lineamientos.se_prioriza_el_material_inedito_para_tra: Unpublished material is prioritized. For student works the requirement is relaxed: coursework or challenge projects are accepted even if not published before, with the committee's approval. For transparency, declare if the piece was submitted in a course or presented at an event.
lineamientos.toda_pieza_con_datos_citas_o_imagenes_de: Every piece with data, quotes or images must properly attribute its sources. Research works go through plagiarism screening with Turnitin before review.
lineamientos.se_permite_como_apoyo_en_tareas_especifi: Se permite como apoyo en tareas específicas (corrección de estilo, asistencia en programación, revisión metodológica), siempre declarado: qué herramienta, con qué finalidad y en qué partes. La revista puede rechazar trabajos ante evidencia o sospecha fundada de uso indebido.
lineamientos.la_revista_busca_en_todo_momento_la_equi: The journal seeks gender equity and equal opportunity at all times, actively pursuing balanced participation across its issues.
lineamientos.todo_dato_lleva_fuente_y_fecha_en_piezas: Every data point carries a source and date. Data pieces include a brief methodological note (origin, cleaning, assumptions and limits). When possible, the repository with code or data used is linked.
lineamientos.cada_pieza_registra_titulo_autoria_filia: Every piece records title, authorship, affiliation and email. Research pieces add an abstract and 3 to 5 keywords; JEL codes and ORCID when available.
lineamientos.se_adopta_chicago_como_estilo_de_citacio: Chicago is adopted as the single citation style, protecting the cleanliness and presentation of the journal.
lineamientos.dos_dictaminadores_evaluan_el_manuscrito: Two referees evaluate the anonymized manuscript with the Master Rubric.
lineamientos.miradas_economicas_y_horizonte_global_cu: Economic Perspectives and Global Horizon when the piece is research.
lineamientos.revisor_estudiante_y_revisor_de_datos_o_: A student reviewer and a data reviewer or professor; focus on sources, method and clarity.
lineamientos.se_verifican_datos_consentimientos_y_der: Data, consents and image rights are verified, and style is edited.
lineamientos.apertura_la_voz_de_la_experiencia_sabias: Editorial Opening, The Voice of Experience, Did You Know?, Social Capital and Excellence in Action.
lineamientos.cada_bloque_incluye_proposito_autoria_fo: Each block includes purpose, authorship, format, what does and does not qualify, mandatory requirements, evaluation criteria and the closing checklist.
lineamientos.publicar_visualizaciones_e_infografias_b: To publish data-driven visualizations and infographics that explain economic phenomena, while bringing practical tools closer (Excel, Python, R, SQL) with a brief how-to.
lineamientos.visualizacion_texto_de_200_a_800_palabra: Visualization + text of 200 to 800 words (capsule ~200, article 500 to 800), with 1 to 3 charts; optional repository with code on GitHub.
lineamientos.visualizaciones_con_fuente_de_datos_expl: Visualizations with an explicit data source and date, stating what they measure and why they matter.
lineamientos.comparaciones_claras_tiempo_regiones_gru: Clear comparisons (time, regions, groups) with a main finding supported by the chart.
lineamientos.metodologia_breve_de_donde_viene_el_dato: Brief methodology: where the data comes from and how it was cleaned or transformed (3 to 4 lines).
lineamientos.recursos_replicables_herramientas_cursos: Replicable resources: tools, courses or resources linked to the case.
lineamientos.graficas_atractivas_sin_pregunta_economi: Pretty charts without an economic question or a verifiable conclusion.
lineamientos.visualizaciones_sin_fuente_sin_fecha_o_c: Visualizations without a source, without a date or with untraceable data.
lineamientos.tutoriales_largos_tipo_manual_tecnico_o_: Long manual-style tutorials or decorative infographics.
lineamientos.fuente_citada_y_fecha_del_dato: Source cited and date of the data.
lineamientos.un_hallazgo_principal_legible_en_el_prop: A main finding readable in the chart itself.
lineamientos.ejes_unidades_y_escalas_correctamente_ro: Axes, units and scales properly labeled.
lineamientos.trazabilidad_del_dato_condicion_de_entra: Data traceability (entry condition), methodological correctness, chart readability (honest scales), value of the finding and usefulness of the how-to.
lineamientos.no_se_publica_sin_fuente_citada_fecha_y_: It is not published without a cited source, a date and a verifiable finding in the chart itself.
lineamientos.conversar_con_economistas_en_activo_para: To talk with working economists to learn how people think and work in the real world, gather well-argued positions and guide the community's professional development.
lineamientos.entrevista_presencial_extractos_de_100_a: In-person interview, excerpts of 100 to 200 words.
lineamientos.consejos_accionables_habilidades_portafo: Actionable advice: skills, portfolio, interviews, first roles, graduate school.
lineamientos.opiniones_ancladas_en_evidencia_o_experi: Opinions anchored in verifiable evidence or experience, with context and limits.
lineamientos.recomendaciones_de_lectura_herramientas_: Reading recommendations, tools and career decisions with examples.
lineamientos.explicacion_accesible_para_estudiantes_s: Accessible explanation for students, without unnecessary jargon.
lineamientos.opinion_politica_o_ideologica_sin_datos_: Political or ideological opinion without data, context or declared assumptions.
lineamientos.comentarios_de_coyuntura_sin_sustento_o_: Commentary on current events without support or with absolute claims.
lineamientos.promocion_personal_o_de_empresa_sin_valo: Personal or company promotion without informative value; attacks on people.
lineamientos.presentacion_de_la_persona_rol_sector_y_: Introduction of the person: role, sector and brief trajectory (2 to 3 lines).
lineamientos.al_menos_3_consejos_o_ideas_accionables: At least 3 actionable tips or ideas.
lineamientos.fuente_cuando_se_citen_datos_o_cifras: Source whenever data or figures are quoted.
lineamientos.consentimiento_del_entrevistado_sobre_la: Interviewee's consent about the publication and their quotes.
lineamientos.valor_practico_anclaje_en_evidencia_o_ex: Practical value, anchoring in evidence or experience, accessibility, structure of the conversation and community interest.
lineamientos.no_se_publica_si_es_motivacion_generica_: It is not published if it is generic motivation without steps or contains data without a source.
lineamientos.difundir_investigaciones_economicas_brev: To disseminate brief economic research to bring academic knowledge closer to the community and the general public. It is the flagship research section and the journal's seal of rigor.
lineamientos.paper_breve_de_hasta_5_cuartillas_aprox_: Brief paper of up to 5 pages (approx. 2,000 to 2,500 words) + QR code to the full document. Discreet graduate label at the top right when applicable. Subsection for research from abroad.
lineamientos.investigacion_original_con_metodologia_c: Original research with qualitative or quantitative methodology and a clear theoretical framework.
lineamientos.estudios_de_caso_modelos_economicos_y_an: Case studies, economic models and public policy analysis.
lineamientos.evidencias_finales_de_materias_y_trabajo: Final coursework evidence and works by challenge-winning teams.
lineamientos.temas_actuales_inflacion_empleo_desigual: Current topics: inflation, employment, inequality, growth, fintech, monetary policy, among others.
lineamientos.divulgacion_general_sin_metodologia_ni_r: General outreach without methodology or references.
lineamientos.marco_teorico_breve_y_metodologia_identi: Brief theoretical framework and identifiable methodology.
lineamientos.hallazgo_principal_implicacion_y_limitac: Main finding, implication and declared limitations.
lineamientos.referencias_completas_y_qr_funcional_al_: Complete references and a working QR to the full paper.
lineamientos.extension_dentro_de_las_5_cuartillas_eti: Length within 5 pages; graduate label if applicable.
lineamientos.con_la_rubrica_del_dictamen_maestro_rele: With the Master Rubric: relevance, clarity of the question, conceptual rigor (critical), evidence and methodology (critical), structure, writing and fit to the format.
lineamientos.no_se_acepta_con_puntaje_menor_a_2_en_ri: It is not accepted with a score below 2 in conceptual rigor, methodology or clarity of the question. Any critical problem prevents an accepted decision.
lineamientos.traducir_la_economia_internacional_a_un_: To translate the international economy into accessible language, apply economic models to contemporary global problems and connect what happens in the world with the local Mexican economy.
lineamientos.analisis_explicativo_aplicado_y_accesibl: Explanatory, applied and accessible analysis of 800 to 1500 words, with supporting charts (source + date).
lineamientos.temas_que_inviten_a_cuestionar_lo_aprend: Topics that invite questioning what was learned in class.
lineamientos.papers_y_ensayos_que_expliquen_como_lo_q: Papers and essays explaining how what happens in Asia or Europe affects the local economy.
lineamientos.ideas_nuevas_o_innovadoras_sobre_la_pers: New or innovative ideas about the global perspective.
lineamientos.resumen_de_lo_que_ya_salio_en_las_notici: A summary of what was already in the news.
lineamientos.lenguaje_excesivamente_tecnico_si_un_alu: Excessively technical language: if a first-semester student cannot understand it, it does not work.
lineamientos.afirmaciones_sin_canales_de_transmision_: Claims without transmission channels or evidence.
lineamientos.hecho_detonante_y_por_que_importa_para_m: Triggering event and why it matters for Mexico.
lineamientos.pregunta_guia_y_un_marco_conceptual_simp: Guiding question and a simple conceptual framework (concept explained).
lineamientos.canales_de_transmision_del_fenomeno_haci: Transmission channels of the phenomenon toward the local economy.
lineamientos.graficas_con_fuente_y_fecha_implicacione: Charts with source and date; implications and a closing with indicators to watch and limits.
lineamientos.aplicacion_conceptual_aplica_teoria_no_r: Conceptual application (applies theory, does not summarize news), explicit and reasoned global-to-local connection, accessibility (passes the first-semester test) and chart evidence with source and date.
lineamientos.no_se_publica_si_es_solo_resumen_de_coyu: It is not published if it is only a summary of current events, without a conceptual framework or a connection with Mexico.
lineamientos.compartir_datos_curiosos_hechos_relevant: To share curious facts, relevant events and brief findings about economics, economists and current affairs, to spark curiosity and broaden the community's economic culture.
lineamientos.capsula_breve_de_100_a_200_palabras_visu: Short capsule of 100 to 200 words, visually attractive (image or chart + concise text).
lineamientos.datos_curiosos_sobre_conceptos_o_fenomen: Curious facts about economic concepts or phenomena.
lineamientos.curiosidades_sobre_economistas_y_sus_apo: Curiosities about economists and their contributions.
lineamientos.explicaciones_breves_de_eventos_economic: Brief explanations of current economic events.
lineamientos.contenido_excesivamente_tecnico_para_el_: Content too technical for the short format.
lineamientos.explicaciones_extensas_que_rompen_el_car: Long explanations that break the capsule character.
lineamientos.fuente_verificable_del_dato_registrada_a: Verifiable source of the fact (recorded even if not fully shown).
lineamientos.un_gancho_claro_que_motive_la_lectura: A clear hook that motivates reading.
lineamientos.veracidad_y_verificabilidad_del_dato_con: Truthfulness and verifiability of the fact (entry condition), interest of the hook, concision and visual clarity.
lineamientos.no_se_publica_si_el_dato_no_es_verificab: It is not published if the fact is not verifiable or is out of context.
lineamientos.documentar_y_fortalecer_la_identidad_de_: To document and strengthen the identity of the student community: events, congresses, experiences and lessons that happen outside the classroom (SALEC, forums, visits, exchanges).
lineamientos.cronica_de_tono_cercano_y_documentado_de: A close-toned, documented chronicle of 500 to 900 words, with 2 to 4 photos and their captions.
lineamientos.relatos_en_primera_persona_sobre_la_vida: First-person accounts about life in the faculty.
lineamientos.metodos_y_tips_de_estudio_para_las_mater: Study methods and tips for economics courses.
lineamientos.charlas_con_profesores_destacados_o_alum: Talks with outstanding professors or students with remarkable projects.
lineamientos.criticas_destructivas_hacia_la_instituci: Destructive criticism of the institution or faculty.
lineamientos.lenguaje_informal_excesivo_se_mantiene_e: Excessively informal language: editorial decorum is maintained.
lineamientos.contenido_sin_conexion_con_la_facultad_o: Content with no connection to the faculty or economics.
lineamientos.que_evento_o_experiencia_se_relata_y_por: What event or experience is narrated and why it matters.
lineamientos.2_a_4_fotos_con_pie_de_foto_que_quien_fe: 2 to 4 photos with captions: what, who, date and place.
lineamientos.revision_previa_de_imagenes_por_el_equip: Prior image review by the Photography and Archive team.
lineamientos.valor_comunitario_precision_factual_fech: Community value, factual accuracy (correct dates, names and places), a close tone with decorum, and visual quality and pertinence.
lineamientos.no_se_publica_con_criticas_destructivas_: It is not published with destructive criticism or with photos without Photography and Archive review or without consent.
lineamientos.reconocer_y_visibilizar_los_logros_acade: To recognize and highlight the academic and professional achievements of the Economics community, to celebrate excellence and strengthen the sense of community.
lineamientos.capsula_de_reconocimiento_foto_nombre_se: Recognition capsule: photo + name + semester, position or affiliation + concise description of the achievement.

lineamientos.datos_correctos_nombre_semestre_o_cargo_: Correct details: name, semester or position, affiliation with the institution.
lineamientos.verificabilidad_del_logro_condicion_de_e: Verifiability of the achievement (entry condition), pertinence, clarity of the capsule, consent and accuracy of details.
lineamientos.no_se_publica_sin_evidencia_del_logro_ni: It is not published without evidence of the achievement or the recognized person's consent.

quienessomos.vertices_es_la_revista_estudiantil_de_ec: Vértices is the student economics journal of Tecnológico de Monterrey, Mexico City Campus, created by and for the community of the Economics undergraduate program (LEC). It was born from a simple idea: a journal
quienessomos.rigurosa_en_la_evidencia_y_amable_en_la_: , rigorous in evidence and friendly to read.
quienessomos.somos_un_espacio_de_encuentro_y_converge: We are a meeting point where ideas converge, where critical thinking, plurality of perspectives and the connection between economic theory and the problems around us are expressed clearly, without unnecessary jargon.
quienessomos.el_punto_de_encuentro_del_rigor_y_las_id: The meeting point of rigor and ideas
quienessomos.ser_el_punto_de_encuentro_y_convergencia: To be the meeting and convergence point of ideas and academic rigor, fostering spaces that contribute to the education of the student community, where knowledge is transformed into new perspectives that question, debate and propose solutions to the economic challenges of today's world.
quienessomos.la_revista_de_economia_referente_a_nivel: The benchmark economics journal at the university level
quienessomos.consolidarnos_como_la_revista_estudianti: To consolidate ourselves as the benchmark student economics journal at the university level, recognized for its critical thinking, its plurality of ideas and its ability to connect economic theory with contemporary global challenges.
quienessomos.los_valores_que_compartimos_con_el_tec: The values we share with Tec
quienessomos.como_proyecto_de_la_comunidad_del_tecnol: As a project of the Tecnológico de Monterrey community, Vértices embraces the institutional values and puts them into editorial practice in every issue.
quienessomos.nos_apasiona_la_disrupcion_que_genera_va: We are passionate about disruption that creates value: we look for formats and questions that renew the economic conversation.
quienessomos.ejercemos_la_libertad_con_responsabilida: We exercise freedom with responsibility: every published claim has transparent sources, methods and authorship.
quienessomos.juntos_alcanzamos_la_vision_la_revista_e: Together we reach the vision: the journal is the work of students, faculty and professionals who review and build as a team.
quienessomos.ponemos_siempre_en_primer_lugar_a_las_pe: We always put people first: we write for anyone who wants to understand and we pursue equity in our authorship.
quienessomos.trabajamos_por_un_mundo_sostenible_conec: We work for a sustainable world: we connect global phenomena with their effects on the local economy.
quienessomos.como_cuidamos_el_rigor_de_lo_que_publica: How we protect the rigor of what we publish
quienessomos.tres_niveles_de_revision_segun_el_tipo_d: Three levels of review depending on the type of piece. Research goes through double-blind review: two people evaluate the anonymized manuscript with a common rubric.
quienessomos.los_trabajos_de_investigacion_pasan_por_: Research works go through plagiarism screening with Turnitin before review, and every piece with data, quotes or images properly attributes its sources.
quienessomos.todo_dato_lleva_fuente_y_fecha_las_pieza: Every data point carries a source and date. Data pieces include a brief methodological note and, when possible, link the repository with the code or data used. We cite in Chicago style.
quienessomos.las_herramientas_de_inteligencia_artific: Artificial intelligence tools are allowed only as declared support (style editing, programming, methodological review). In peer-reviewed research, generative AI is not allowed to produce the manuscript's content.
quienessomos.buscamos_de_manera_activa_la_participaci: We actively pursue balanced participation and track the authorship balance in every issue.

quienessomos.la_convocatoria_esta_abierta_estudiantes: The call is open: economics students, degreed economists, data scientists and social scientists.
